headline: Claude Maps the Bug Hunt
lede: Claude-BugHunter turns authorized security work into a disciplined operating system for reconnaissance, validation, and evidence. Its 83 skills and 681 vulnerability-report patterns give agents a bounded playbook for finding flaws without losing scope or reporting rigor.

headline: Superpowers Gives Coding Agents a Method
lede: Superpowers replaces improvisation with a staged engineering protocol: discover requirements, validate a design, plan the work, then implement in tested increments. Worktrees, subagents, and explicit review points give autonomous coding a stronger architectural frame.

headline: CLI-Anything Makes Software Operable
lede: CLI-Anything converts desktop applications, games, services, and developer tools into structured command-line interfaces that agents can drive. Its harnesses and CLI-Hub registry turn scattered integrations into installable, testable utilities for real workflows.

headline: MiniMind Puts Model Training on a Desk
lede: MiniMind compresses the language-model learning curve into a roughly 64-million-parameter project that can train on a consumer GPU. Its native PyTorch pipeline covers pretraining, alignment, distillation, tool use, and serving without hiding the machinery behind opaque abstractions.

headline: Cursor Plugins Connect Agents to Work
lede: Cursor’s plugin catalog packages agent skills, orchestration patterns, code review, and business-system integrations behind a consistent manifest format. The result is an extensible operations layer that reaches from repositories and SDKs to CRM, recruiting, and productivity tools.

headline: Firecrawl Gives Agents the Living Web
lede: Firecrawl turns dynamic pages, documents, and interactive sites into structured material that language models can use. Rendering, crawling, proxy rotation, rate limits, monitoring, and browser actions flow through one pipeline for research and retrieval systems.

headline: NGINX Keeps the Edge Moving
lede: NGINX remains a compact traffic engine for serving content, terminating TLS, balancing requests, proxying APIs, and caching responses. Its master-worker architecture and modular configuration keep high-throughput deployments direct, tunable, and economical.

headline: OpenVINO Trims Models for Intel Silicon
lede: OpenVINO converts models from major training frameworks into an optimized representation for CPU, GPU, and NPU inference. Quantization, sparsity, serving APIs, and broad language-model integrations make deployment performance measurable rather than incidental.

headline: Diagram Design Turns Prompts into Systems
lede: Diagram Design translates plain-language briefs into polished, standalone HTML and SVG diagrams across 44 visual formats. Grid checks, overlap detection, brand extraction, and editable output give agent-generated visuals a dependable design system.

headline: Last30Days Builds an Evidence Trail
lede: Last30days-skill assembles a recent-topic brief from communities, video, markets, news, code, research, and the wider web. Parallel searches, source signals, and attributable supporting material turn scattered conversation into a compact research record.
